name: Tink Bell
source:
An “anything goes” fairy who is fine with even inhumane acts. He’s optimistic and playful, as long as it’s fun, he’s even fine with lying.

It’s unsure where his seriousness begins and where it ends, and he can’t distinguish between good and evil.

He likes the sweet and cold popsicles.

[From [url=http://appleforest.livejournal.com/4145.html]Appleforest at Livejournal[/url]]
